matterContext: Civil — small claims, withheld security deposit (plaintiff)

case.summary: Plaintiff moved out of a rental on good terms and returned the keys, but the landlord withheld the entire $2,400 security deposit, claiming 'cleaning and damages.' Plaintiff has photos showing the unit was clean and an itemized list was never provided within the statutory window.
case.reliefSought: Return of the $2,400 deposit, plus any statutory penalty for an improperly withheld deposit.

timeline.event: Lease ended; plaintiff returned keys and provided forwarding address.
Plaintiff took dated move-out photos of every room.
Landlord emailed that the full deposit was withheld; no itemized statement attached.
Plaintiff sent a written demand for the deposit and itemization; no response.

evidence.description: Dated move-out photos of all rooms showing a clean, undamaged unit.
Signed lease stating the deposit amount and return terms.
Email from landlord withholding the deposit, and plaintiff's unanswered written demand.
